alibabacloud-lingjun-node-ops 0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Introduces full lifecycle management for Alibaba Cloud Lingjun (hyper-)nodes, covering stop, reboot, reimage, renewal, spec change, repair, run-command, node group update, tagging, and resource group operations.
- Enforces single-step parameter confirmation before all mutations, supporting both Chinese and English with canonical feature names and prompts.
- Uses a persistent per-session random session ID for observability; every CLI call embeds this in the user-agent.
- Requires read-only inventory retrieval as a prerequisite for all mutating operations.
- Details region support, CLI installation, authentication best practices, and fine-grained RAM permission sets.
- Excludes cluster scaling, node group moves, and file delivery, which are covered by a separate skill.
